desc: The Cowboy Defender was designed forCowboy Action or the Most Compact CarryConcealed .410 shotshell protection available.The overall appearance is similar tothe Remington Double Derringer of the1860's. The Cowboy Defender will acceptall the extra interchangeable barrels. Interchangeable Barrels. Automatic Extractor. (EXCEPT FOR 9mm,40S&W,10mm and .45 ACP). Rebounding Hammer. Retracting Firing Pins. Crossbolt Safety. Spring-Loaded Cammed Locking Lever, for a tighter barrel/frame fit and Rapid loading and unloading). Stainless Steel with Satin Polish Finish. Trigger guard NOT availible).
